extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent counsel, and USPTO administrative patent judges/practitioners involved in ex parte appeals
extracted.subtask_description: Order convening an Appeals Review Panel (ARP) to grant sua sponte rehearing of a Board decision, with the ARP focused on the Board's new ground of rejection under 35 U.S.C. §101 for specified claims and limited to the current record (no further briefing).

rubrics_metrics.name: ARP review focus: 35 U.S.C. §101 rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARP review will focus on the Board's new ground of rejection of claims 1-6 and 8-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 101.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rehearing will examine the Board's Decision on Appeal and Decision on Request for Rehearing with respect to the newly articulated §101 rejection of the identified claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehearing granted sua sponte
rubrics_metrics.description: The panel has determined to grant rehearing sua sponte to review the Board's Decision on Appeal and Decision on Request for Rehearing in the above-captioned case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ARP may on its own initiative grant rehearing; this order exercises that authority and supersedes the earlier ARP-convening order issued August 8, 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehearing limited to the current record
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARP will conduct the rehearing based on the current record and no further briefing is authorized at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parties should not expect to submit additional briefing; the panel's review is confined to materials already in the record. Any time period for reply, if authorized, is set in an attached communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope identified by specific claims
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARP's review is specifically directed to claims 1-6 and 8-20 as to the new §101 ground of rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The review and any resulting decision will pertain to the listed claims; other claims or issues not identified for review are not the focus of this rehearing order.
